about:
Dr. Rohan H. Dave is a physiotherapist, clinic owner, sports physiotherapist, and rehabilitation specialist based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, with professional experience dating back to 2003. The clinical practice focuses on the management of pain, stroke rehabilitation, sports injuries, and rehabilitation following surgery, with a broad clinical focus spanning musculoskeletal and neurological rehabilitation. The approach is centered on supporting patients through pain management, functional recovery, improved mobility, strengthening, and rehabilitation following injuries and surgical procedures.

Dr. Dave is the Clinic Owner of Krishna Physiotherapy and Pain Rehabilitation Clinic in Ahmedabad. The clinical practice encompasses physiotherapy care for lower back pain, neck pain, cervical spondylosis, postural correction, sports injuries, knee pain and osteoarthritis, shoulder pain and frozen shoulder, slip disc and sciatica, post-operative rehabilitation, muscle recovery, mobility and strengthening, and ergonomic correction. Services are available through in-clinic consultations, home visits, online physiotherapy consultations, sports team consultations, and corporate ergonomics consultations, supporting athletes, working professionals, elderly patients, post-surgical rehabilitation cases, chronic pain patients, and women’s health needs.

Professional Highlights

  • Over 20 years of professional experience, with physiotherapy practice dating back to 2003.
  • Professional roles include Clinic Owner, Consulting Physiotherapist, Sports Physiotherapist, and Rehabilitation Specialist.
  • Founder and clinic owner of Krishna Physiotherapy and Pain Rehabilitation Clinic in Ahmedabad.
  • Specializes in the management of pain, stroke rehabilitation, sports injuries, and rehabilitation following surgeries.
  • Extensive clinical focus across musculoskeletal and neurological rehabilitation, supporting patients through different stages of recovery.
  • Clinical expertise includes lower back pain, neck pain, cervical spondylosis, postural correction, sports injuries, knee pain and osteoarthritis, shoulder pain and frozen shoulder, slip disc and sciatica.
  • Rehabilitation expertise encompasses post-operative recovery, muscle recovery, mobility and strengthening, and ergonomic correction.

title: Dr. Swati Mendhe (PT)
about:
Dr. Swati Mendhe is a dedicated Physiotherapist based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with 1.5 years of professional experience. She holds a Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) from P. E. S. Modern College of Physiotherapy, Pune, with a focus on Orthopaedic Physiotherapy and Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation.

Her practice combines evidence-based rehabilitation with a patient-centred approach, particularly in sports injury rehabilitation, ACL injury management, and geriatric rehabilitation. She believes recovery is not simply about healing an injury but also about restoring confidence, movement, strength, and the ability to return safely to everyday and sporting activities.

Areas of Expertise

  • Orthopaedic Physiotherapy
  • Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation
  • Sports Injury Rehabilitation
  • ACL Injury Management
  • Geriatric Rehabilitation
  • Post-Surgical Rehabilitation
  • Knee Pain & Osteoarthritis
  • Cervical Spondylosis
  • Shoulder Pain & Frozen Shoulder
  • Postural Correction
  • Muscle Recovery
  • Mobility & Strengthening

Sports & ACL Rehabilitation

Dr. Swati has a strong interest in sports injury rehabilitation, with particular expertise in ACL injury management. Whether an injury is managed conservatively or following surgery, she follows a structured rehabilitation approach focused on:

  • Restoring range of motion
  • Rebuilding strength
  • Improving neuromuscular control
  • Progressive functional rehabilitation
  • Sport-specific training
  • Injury-prevention education
  • Safe return to activity and sports

Her experience with athletes has shaped her understanding that successful rehabilitation involves rebuilding both physical capability and confidence.

Geriatric Rehabilitation

Dr. Swati also specializes in geriatric rehabilitation, helping older adults improve mobility, balance, strength, and independence.

Her rehabilitation approach focuses on:

  • Improving functional mobility
  • Enhancing balance and stability
  • Strengthening weakened muscle groups
  • Reducing pain and movement limitations
  • Supporting fall prevention
  • Helping patients maintain independence in daily activities

Patient-Centred Approach

Dr. Swati believes physiotherapy should be a partnership between the therapist and patient. She emphasizes listening, educating, and empowering patients throughout their rehabilitation journey.

Her goal is simple: to help people move better, feel stronger, and return to the activities they enjoy without unnecessary limitations.

name: DR.Pratiksha Munde
title: Dr Pratiksha Munde(PT)
about:
About Dr. Pratiksha Munde

Dr. Pratiksha Munde is a Physiotherapist and Rehabilitation Specialist based in Pune, Maharashtra, with 3–4 years of professional experience. She holds a Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) and a Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) with specialization in Cardiopulmonary Physiotherapy.

Her clinical practice covers a broad range of musculoskeletal, neurological, pediatric, community-based, and cardiopulmonary conditions. She takes an evidence-based and individualized approach to rehabilitation, focusing on restoring function, improving mobility, managing pain, and enhancing overall quality of life.

Professional Highlights

  • 3–4 years of professional physiotherapy experience
  • BPT & MPT in Cardiopulmonary Physiotherapy
  • Rehabilitation Specialist and Freelance/Home Visit Physiotherapist
  • Experience across musculoskeletal, neurological, pediatric, and cardiopulmonary rehabilitation
  • Trained in multiple advanced physiotherapy techniques
  • Experience providing physiotherapy support at marathon and sporting events

Areas of Expertise

  • Cardiopulmonary Rehabilitation
  • Cardiovascular & Respiratory Rehabilitation
  • Pre- and Post-Operative Rehabilitation
  • Lower Back & Neck Pain
  • Cervical Spondylosis
  • Knee Pain & Osteoarthritis
  • Shoulder Pain & Frozen Shoulder
  • Sports Injuries
  • Slip Disc & Sciatica
  • Neurological Rehabilitation
  • Pediatric Rehabilitation
  • Mobility & Strengthening
  • Postural & Biomechanical Correction
  • Ergonomic Correction

Cardiopulmonary Expertise

Dr. Pratiksha has a special interest in cardiovascular and respiratory rehabilitation. She works with patients during pre-operative and post-operative stages and has experience managing rehabilitation for conditions including:

  • Myocardial Infarction (MI)
  • Coronary Artery Disease (CAD)
  • Hypertension
  • COPD
  • Asthma
  • Pneumonia
  • Cardiac and thoracic surgery recovery

Advanced Techniques & Training

Her professional training includes:

  • Advanced biomechanical correction of the spine
  • Dry Needling
  • Cupping Therapy
  • Therapeutic Taping
  • Lymphedema Management
  • Good Clinical Practice Training
  • Basic Research Methodology

Patient-Care Philosophy

Dr. Pratiksha believes in providing personalized, evidence-based rehabilitation based on each patient’s condition, goals, and functional needs. Her approach combines clinical assessment, targeted therapeutic techniques, functional rehabilitation, and patient education to help individuals achieve sustainable improvements in movement, independence, and quality of life.

Her approach integrates clinical expertise, technology, movement science, patient education, and active rehabilitation to help individuals manage pain, prevent recurrence, and move with confidence.

name: Dr. Reva Dilip Rajurkar (PT)
title: Dr. Reva Dilip Rajurkar (PT)
about:
Dr. Reva Dilip Rajurkar (PT) is a neurophysiotherapist based in Pune, Maharashtra, with a Master’s in Neurological Rehabilitation from the University of Plymouth, UK. She currently practices at Q-Point by 22Neuro, specializing in neurorehabilitation for conditions including stroke, Parkinson’s disease, traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis, neuropathy, cerebral palsy, and cognitive impairment.

Her clinical approach is evidence-based and deeply patient-centred, drawing on her certifications in LSVT BIG® (Parkinson’s), PNF, and NDT — including a newly completed NDT Aware Practitioner (Level II) certification (July 2026). She has additional expertise in gait and balance rehabilitation, spasticity management, and cognitive rehabilitation, with hands-on experience in QEEG and HRV-based therapy planning.

She has published four peer-reviewed case reports and volunteered with University Hospitals Plymouth NHS Trust. She is a registered member of the Indian Association of Physiotherapists (IAP) and the Maharashtra State Council for Occupational Therapy & Physiotherapy.

Her mission is simple: to help individuals not just recover function, but reclaim a life lived with dignity.

The clinical approach focuses on personalised rehabilitation, patient education, therapeutic exercise, and sustainable lifestyle modifications. Areas of special interest include spine rehabilitation, posture correction, ergonomic assessment, diabetic rehabilitation, chronic pain management, and functional recovery following injury or surgery.

As the founder of ReJenesis Physiotherapy, Dr. Jennifer Pinto provides accessible physiotherapy services through home visits, tele-rehabilitation, and preventive health education. Treatment plans are customised according to individual needs and functional goals, with an emphasis on improving mobility, reducing pain, and supporting long-term recovery.

name: Dr. Diganta Das (PT)
title: Dr. Diganta Das (PT)
about:
Dr. Diganta Das is a passionate and experienced Physiotherapist with 13 years of clinical expertise, including over three years of service under the National Health Mission (NHM), Assam. Currently serving as a Senior Physiotherapist at S.K. Roy Civil Hospital, Hailakandi, he provides evidence-based, patient-centered rehabilitation for individuals with orthopedic, neurological, pediatric, and musculoskeletal conditions. He completed his Bachelor of Physiotherapy from Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS), Bengaluru, and pursued a Fellowship in Orthopedic Rehabilitation to further strengthen his clinical expertise. His professional interests include musculoskeletal rehabilitation, neurorehabilitation, pediatric physiotherapy, manual therapy, kinesio taping, myofascial trigger point therapy, and critical care physiotherapy. Beyond his clinical responsibilities, he is deeply committed to improving awareness and accessibility of physiotherapy, particularly in rural communities such as Hailakandi. He develops patient education materials and translates them into local languages, making physiotherapy concepts easier to understand and more relevant to the people he serves. Through community outreach, educational campaigns, and digital platforms, he strives to dispel myths, encourage early rehabilitation, and empower patients and their families to actively participate in their recovery. For him, physiotherapy is more than a profession—it is an opportunity to restore mobility, independence, and hope while ensuring that even those in underserved areas have access to reliable, evidence-based rehabilitation and the knowledge to make informed decisions about their health.

about:

name: Dr. Zoya Zaidi
title: Dr. Zoya Zaidi
about:
I am a Sports Physiotherapist with over 6 years of clinical experience, specializing in the assessment, rehabilitation, and performance optimization of both athletes and active individuals. My core expertise lies in managing orthopedic and sports-related conditions, particularly ACL and meniscus injuries, lower back pain, and shoulder dysfunctions. I take a patient-centered, evidence-based approach to treatment, combining manual therapy, myofascial release, dry needling, and corrective exercise techniques to ensure optimal recovery and long-term results.

I commonly work with athletes, dancers, gym-goers, and working professionals dealing with acute injuries, post-surgical rehabilitation, or chronic pain conditions. I also have a growing interest in women’s health physiotherapy, including pregnancy-related care, postpartum recovery, and pelvic floor rehabilitation.

My goal is not just to relieve pain but to restore function, prevent recurrence, and help individuals return confidently to their daily activities or sport.

about:

I mainly treat patients with knee osteoarthritis, fractures, low back pain, and soft tissue injuries, focusing on pain relief and functional recovery. My certifications include CCT, CKTP, and CDNT (CPD UK). I am also a certified Pre and Post Natal Fitness Instructor through IAFT. I also hold additional certifications including WOW IIPRE and FPFRS, supporting a comprehensive, evidence-based, and patient-centered approach to physiotherapy practice.”

Under his apt leadership, a team of expert Physiotherapists has treated more than 25000 patients successfully at his clinics. He has a holistic approach towards physiotherapy and hence provides both manual and instrument equipped treatments to his patients all across the city.

about:
With over 15 years of hands-on experience in physiotherapy and rehabilitation, Dr. Sandip Sankar Ghosh (PT) brings expertise, compassion, and convenience right to your doorstep in Kolkata.

A proud intern of the Bangur Institute of Neuroscience, Dr. Ghosh has honed his skills at some of the most respected healthcare institutions, including Ramakrishna Mission Seva Pratishthan, Rehabilitation Centre for Children, Care Continuum, and Portea Medical. His journey has always been guided by one goal: to help people move better, live pain-free, and regain control of their lives—no matter their age or condition.

Certified in the globally recognized Mulligan Technique, he specializes in gentle yet effective manual therapy for joint mobilization and pain relief. Dr. Ghosh now focuses on personalized physiotherapy sessions in the comfort of your home, eliminating travel hassles and offering tailored care for faster recovery.

Whether you’re dealing with neurological conditions, post-surgical rehab, chronic pain, or age-related mobility issues, Dr. Ghosh is committed to walking every step of your healing journey with you.

name: Dr. Avantika Jain
title: Dr. Avantika Jain, Physiotherapist, Delhi, Delhi (NCT)
about:
Dr. Avantika Jain is a practising Physiotherapist with 15 years of clinical experience in musculoskeletal rehabilitation, geriatric physiotherapy and the management of a wide range of joint and movement-related conditions. The clinical practice focuses on comprehensive assessment, individualized rehabilitation planning and improving mobility, strength, balance and functional independence.

Dr. Avantika Jain holds a Master’s degree in Musculoskeletal Sciences from the University of Pittsburgh and has extensive experience working with geriatric patients presenting with complex musculoskeletal and joint conditions. Clinical expertise includes the management of shoulder conditions, cervical issues, lower back pain, knee osteoarthritis, post-knee replacement rehabilitation and rheumatoid arthritis.

Alongside musculoskeletal rehabilitation, Dr. Avantika Jain has significant experience in the physiotherapy management of patients with Parkinson’s disease. The rehabilitation approach places particular emphasis on balance, mobility and movement, which are important components of maintaining functional independence among individuals with movement disorders.

The practice also addresses postural concerns, sports injuries, chronic pain, neurological rehabilitation and post-operative recovery. Consultation services are available through in-clinic appointments, home visits, online physiotherapy consultations and corporate ergonomics programs.

Professional Highlights

  • 15 years of clinical experience in physiotherapy.
  • Specialization in Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation.
  • Master’s education in Musculoskeletal Sciences from the University of Pittsburgh.
  • Extensive clinical experience in geriatric physiotherapy and musculoskeletal rehabilitation.
  • Experience managing shoulder conditions, cervical issues, lower back pain, knee osteoarthritis and post-knee replacement rehabilitation.
  • Experience in the physiotherapy management of rheumatoid arthritis.
  • Clinical experience in Parkinson’s disease rehabilitation, with a focus on balance, mobility and movement.
  • Experience in post-operative rehabilitation, chronic pain management and functional recovery.
  • Provides in-clinic, home-visit, online and corporate ergonomics consultations.

name: Dr. Jainil Choksi
title: Dr. Jainil Choksi
about:
Dr. Jainil Choksi is a Consultant Physiotherapist specializing in advanced neurological rehabilitation, delivering precision-driven, outcome-focused care for individuals seeking the highest standard of physiotherapy.

His clinical expertise includes the management of complex neurological conditions such as stroke, spinal cord injury, Parkinson’s disease, traumatic brain injury, multiple sclerosis, Guillain- Barré syndrome, and myasthenia gravis, utilizing refined, neuroplasticity-based rehabilitation strategies to restore function and independence.

In musculoskeletal practice, he treats high- demand and chronic conditions including spinal disorders, rotator cuff injuries, ligament injuries, movement dysfunctions, and persistent pain syndromes-focusing on correcting underlying biomechanics rather than providing temporary
relief.

He also works with active individuals and athletes, guiding structured recovery, performance optimization, and safe return to sport.

Recognized for his analytical approach and attention to detail, Dr. Jainil offers a bespoke rehabilitation experience where clinical precision meets personalized care, ensuring measurable and lasting results.

about:
Dr. M. Sundari started her profession as a clinical physiotherapist at Sooriya Hospitals, Chennai. She worked in Sooriya Hospital from 2001 to 2004 as a rotational physiotherapist. Later in 2005 she worked in physio vision for almost 6 months and went on for specialization in Neurodevelopmental Therapy and Sensory Integration at The Spastic Society of Tamil Nadu for a year. She worked in SRMC, Porur and also worked as a consultant physiotherapist in pediatric care in a couple of clinics in the year 2006.

She started her private practice at Gokulam Child Development And Rehab Services since 2007. She has also done international certification in Neurodevelopmental Therapy, Aquatic Therapy, Sensory Integration, manual therapy and recent advanced treatment strategies which would benefit the children based on their presentation/behaviour. She treats children with delayed in developmental milestone, cerebral palsy, down syndrome, autism spectrum disorder, ADHD, sensory processing disorder, other genetic disorders, learning disability, etc. She is heading the team which includes occupational therapy, physiotherapist, psychologist, special educator, speech therapist. All the facilities are available under one roof. Our motto is service to children and helps the children to cope with the day to day needs, socialize, communicate for their basic needs and above all to become functionally independent in their life.

They have Learning Center (Gokulam School for Children with Specific Learning Disability

and Cerebral Palsy which was established in the year 2012) which mainly focuses on children from 0 to 8 years of age., to promote development in all domains like ADLs, Cognitive,Socialization and Fine and gross motor areas, the school focus on parent centered. referred to a normal school. They believe in parental guidance and also provide inputs to parents, a home programme to them. We welcome parents to become the active participant in the therapy time.

Recently they added functional vision therapy and psychological counseling for parents and adults.

Gokulam has now expanded the services by extending another 1000 sq. ft. in the ground floor to focus mainly on Women’s Wellness, Geriatric population and Adult Rehab focusing on Movement Health and Wellness.

Treatment includes recent advanced treatment techniques such as Kinetic Control, Manual therapy after thorough clinical evaluation of the patient condition. Our mission is “Optimising the Movement Health!” Of all domain of people!

Aquatic therapy for orthopaedic condition like frozen shoulder, back pain, knee pain, sports injuries rehab and fitness, postoperative orthopaedic, neurological problems like spinal cord injuries,stroke, balance problems, coordination,cerebral palsy, autism, ADHD, etc. Are treated with greater functional outcome!

name: Dr. Sarath kumar N
title: Dr. Sarath kumar N
about:
Dr. Sarath Kumar N (PT), MPT (Sports), MIAP

Consultant Sports, Shoulder & Spine Care Physiotherapist

Dr. Sarath Kumar N is a highly skilled physiotherapist specializing in Sports, Shoulder, and Spine rehabilitation. He holds a Master of Physiotherapy (Sports) degree from VISTAS, Chennai, and a Bachelor of Physiotherapy degree from SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai.

With extensive clinical experience, Dr. Sarath has developed expertise in managing sports-related injuries, musculoskeletal conditions, and post-operative rehabilitation. His special interests include prehabilitation and rehabilitation for athletes, orthopaedic rehabilitation, ergonomics, posture correction, and advanced cancer rehabilitation (including trismus, lymphedema, and post-operative shoulder stiffness).

He has been trained and certified in Manual Therapy from Bangalore, completed a Masterclass in Advanced Spine Care, and brings a hands-on approach that combines evidence-based physiotherapy with patient-specific treatment protocols. His work in lymphedema management is especially noteworthy, helping patients regain function and improve quality of life after oncological surgeries.

Dr. Sarath has also served as a sports physiotherapist for a Super Division Football team in Bangalore, where he gained valuable on-field and off-field experience in injury prevention, sports rehabilitation, and performance optimization for professional athletes.

Beyond clinical practice, Dr. Sarath is the founder of the Good Physio Community—an initiative dedicated to shaping better physiotherapists for the future. Through this platform, he conducts online webinars, workshops, clinical reasoning programs, and structured training modules that help young professionals enhance their skills and clinical decision-making. The community also focuses on creating awareness about healthy lifestyles for desk professionals and contributing towards sustainable health and wellness practices.

Known for his patient-centric care, strong clinical reasoning, and ability to simplify complex conditions, Dr. Sarath has successfully treated hundreds of patients, including athletes, desk professionals, and post-surgical cases, ensuring safe recovery and long-term functional improvement.

Dr. Shanmuga Pillai (BPTh/BPT, MPTh/MPT – Orthopedic Physiotherapy) is an experienced physiotherapist with 6–10 years of clinical expertise in the field of orthopedic physiotherapy, musculoskeletal rehabilitation, and pain management. He practices at SK Physiotherapy Clinic, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru, Karnataka, and is known for his evidence-based, patient-centered approach to rehabilitation and recovery.

With specialized training in Orthopedic Physiotherapy, Dr. Shanmuga Pillai focuses on the diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation of musculoskeletal and orthopedic conditions, helping patients overcome pain, improve mobility, and regain functional independence. His treatment approach combines advanced physiotherapy techniques with personalized exercise programs designed to support long-term recovery and overall physical well-being.

At SK Physiotherapy Clinic, located at CMR Tower, Basement, Numbers 44, 45 & 46, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru, near the BBMP Office, Dr. Shanmuga Pillai provides comprehensive physiotherapy care for patients recovering from injuries, chronic pain conditions, sports-related issues, and post-surgical limitations. His individualized treatment plans are tailored to each patient’s unique needs and rehabilitation goals.

About Dr. Aamir K.(PT)

Dr. Aamir K. (BPTh/BPT, Master of Physiotherapy) is an experienced physiotherapist with over 11–15 years of clinical expertise in the field of physiotherapy rehabilitation, musculoskeletal care, and pain management. He practices at Quantum Physiotherapy Clinic, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka, and is known for his structured, evidence-based, and patient-focused approach to rehabilitation.

With advanced training in physiotherapy, Dr. Aamir K. specializes in the assessment and management of a wide range of orthopedic and musculoskeletal conditions, including spine disorders, joint pain, sports injuries, and post-surgical rehabilitation. His treatment philosophy emphasizes pain reduction, mobility restoration, posture correction, strength enhancement, and long-term functional recovery to help patients return to their daily activities with improved quality of life.

At Quantum Physiotherapy Clinic, located at 1289, Ground Floor, 17th Cross, 5th Main Road, Sector 7, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, near Star Bazaar, Dr. Aamir provides comprehensive physiotherapy services tailored to individual patient needs, ensuring targeted recovery plans and sustainable results.

name: Dr. Arif Azam
title: Dr. Arif Azam
about:
Dr. Arif Azam had always wanted to do something within the medical field. Being able to spend quality time with patients and being able to watch them progress and improve is what makes physical therapy such a wonderful profession. Being able to watch a patient progress over time and knowing you had a hand in their recovery is very rewarding experience. He would like to keep a light and friendly atmosphere in my clinic while making sure that my patients perform their therapeutic exercise programs effectively and proficiently. He strives to have his patients get the most out of the time they spend with him so that they can improve on a daily basis. He gives a better quality of life than what they had when they first entered our practice t his patients. Being able to return a patient to pre-injury condition or better is key to a successful outcome.

Dr. Arif Azam has over 10 years of clinical experience in treating patients. His clinical expertise specializes in back and neck pain, such as herniated disc, sports injuries. Dr. Arif Azam is committed to providing pain relief for many symptoms and conditions so that you can have a higher quality of life. He uses a gentle hands on and instrument technique to help anyone of any age. He has extra training in working with spinal disc related problems and joint problems.

Dr. K. Poongodi is a Senior Physiotherapy Consultant in Porur, Chennai and has an experience of 14 years in this field. She completed BPTh/BPT from The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University (KMCH) in 2005.She is a member of Indian Association of Physiotherapist.

Bringing about incredible improvement in the lifestyle of patients is Sugam physiotherapy clinic at Porur, Chennai. A physiotherapist, the practitioner has been practicing since 2005. The clinic is located at a prominent location in the city at Ramakrishna nagar main in Porur. Though situated in a notable neighbourhood, those new to the location can easily spot the clinic as it stands Ramakrishna nagar main, an eminent landmark in the vicinity. With regards to commuting, the location is accessible by a number of modes of public transportation which make it convenient for patients to be on their way to the physiotherapist’s clinic.

Services Offered by Sugam physiotherapy clinic

Sugam physiotherapy clinic at Porur is known to bring about mobility in patients after an injury or ailment that is detrimental to movement of a part of the body or the entire body. The entire process involves examination, prognosis and treatment which results in promoting mobility, flexibility and function of the affected area. The various exercises suggested by the practitioner restore maximum movement. The treatment is provided depending on the cause of inactivity which could be a result of a physical injury, a medical condition, ageing or environmental factors. The doctor specializes in rendering treatment to patients suffering from arthritis, spondylitis,Back Pain, Neck Pain,knee Pain,Strengthening,Sports Physiotherapy and musculoskeletal disorders. Other than this, the doctor also conducts post operative physiotherapy sessions for patients who have undergone a surgery and have limited or no movement of a part of the body.
